title: Metadata Dataset of Medieval Churches from Central Europe

creators.name: Hassenbach, Jona Marie
creators.affiliation: Digital Humanities Center, Walter Benjamin Kolleg, University of Bern

description: This publication contains two final datasets of medieval churches from Central Europe for a study of church orientations, astronomical sunrise dates, and associated saints. The original church records were pulled from the THANADOS database.
